atomicity.reason: A single obligation: set one warning on one interface under one condition.

comprehensibility.reason: Intelligible on its own: it names the two measured extremes, the limit and where the warning appears.

feasibility.reason: Min/max over readings already acquired for protection; no technology constraint.

parent_fit.reason: The parent story promises the spread between warmest and coldest cell STAYS inside a stated band; this requirement only raises a warning once 8 K is exceeded, so it makes the condition visible without delivering the containment the parent asks for, and no other requirement in the set bounds the spread.
parent_fit.suggestion: Either add a requirement that actually bounds the spread (balancing or thermal control) and keep this one as its diagnostic complement, or correct the parent story's observable so a workshop-visible warning is what is being promised.

unambiguity.reason: The set condition is precise but no clearing or reset condition is given - unlike the cooling and heating requests, which state their withdraw thresholds - so it is open whether the warning is latched or self-clearing, and whether a momentary spread excursion must set it.
unambiguity.suggestion: State the clearing condition and any debounce, e.g. withdraw the warning below 6 K after the spread has been under the limit for a stated time, or hold it until a diagnostic clear.

verifiability.reason: The quantity (highest minus lowest valid cell temperature), the 8 K threshold and the observable (diagnostic-interface warning) are all concrete.

summary: Well-quantified diagnostic warning, but it only detects the imbalance the parent story promises to contain, and it states no condition for clearing the warning.
